My view is also visible there 😀
Yeah right, the French complaining about English only communication. Makes the rest of us non-English, non-French feel... ugh #2018tef
Let's talk about democratization of #MT building and training. Google, e.g., offers open-source tools. For the moment, it's for the experts and the rich (needs lots of GPU etc) #2018tef

So, fellow #translators, make sure you stay up-to-date. Stop whining and complaining about machines stealing jobs and see what you can do to fit in the changing landscape https://twitter.com/emmabecciu/status/1060489142084272128
#MT systems are not developed with the #translator in mind. And that's only natural. Their ultimate goal is to replace the intermediary between source and target #2018tef
#NMT does not provide fuzzy matches for easy post-editing. Quality estimation is extremely difficult. We first need to become more confident in understanding NMT outputs #2018tef

Does using #NMT need a different skillset from #MT? Translators don't need to learn how ot code (don't need to know how the motor works to drive a car). But it's a good idea to know the reality behind the hype #2018tef
Most CAT tools presenting only one of the possible solutions? Not in my experience! #2018tef
Is #NMT the enemy of translators? It's definitely the elephant in the room #2018tef
With constrained decoding - now able to handle terminology in #NMT (previously not possible) #2018tef
#NMT produces very fluent translations which are often VERY wrong #2018tef
#NMT working well with low resource scenarios (e.g. rare language pairs) #2018tef
#NMT needs cleaner and in-domain data (less is more). Smart people are needed to manipulate the algorithms, look into the "black box" #2018tef
#NMT Not a black box as long as there humans involved in the algorithms. You just can't trace a result easily #2018tef
Didn't appreciate the speakers comment that "all maths and vectors are not for this audience, not for linguists" #2018tef
#NMT another hype? My question too! #2018tef
And now an all-male panel. This time started with a public comment on this. I look forward to the days these comments are totally irrelevant #2018tef

Who likes doing repetitive tasks? These jobs are gone. Linguists and translators can adapt to new developments. In any case, humans should be in the loop (even for self-driving cars). We need a mindset that embraces change, keep training, make best use of AI #2018tef
People noticed that the panel on #AI is all-female. I didn't. And I wouldn't if it was all-male. Does it even matter? Am I too used to seeing women in panels? #2018tef

"Do not assume something is objective simply because it is #datadriven" Well, users of Facebook should know about #algorithm bias. But even with robust algorithms, data should be good too (not poorly selected, incomplete, outdated) #2018tef

#AI in everyday life: We have enough regulations, do not need more. Trust is good, but proof of trust is better. Transparency algorithmic tools are needed: algorithms checking that other algorithms are doing what they are supposed to do #2018TEF
